recipes.name: Pan-fried salmon with lemon and caper butter
recipes.method_note: Leave the fish alone while the skin crisps. It lets go of the pan when it is ready.

steps.instruction: Pat {{ing:salmon-fillet}} dry. Season with salt.
Put a frying pan on a medium-high heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry skin side down 4 minutes, pressing gently, until the skin is crisp.
Turn. Cook 3 minutes more, until the fish flakes. Lift onto plates.
Add {{ing:butter-unsalted}} to the pan. Let it foam. Add {{ing:capers}}, the juice of {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

recipes.name: Steak with green peppercorn sauce

steps.instruction: Season {{ing:beef-sirloin}} with {{ing:salt}}.
Put a frying pan on a high heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry 3 minutes a side for medium-rare, turning once.
Rest on a warm plate 5 minutes.
Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} in the pan 2 minutes. Add {{ing:green-peppercorns-brine}} and {{ing:double-cream}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over to serve.

recipes.name: Sweetcorn fritters with avocado salsa

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} to a thick batter.
Stir in drained {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}} and sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Put a frying pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Fry spoonfuls 3 minutes a side, until golden.
Dice {{ing:avocado}} with the juice of {{ing:lime}}. Spoon on top.

recipes.name: Pea and feta fritters

steps.instruction: Defrost {{ing:peas-frozen}}. Crush lightly.
Mix with crumbled {{ing:feta}}, {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Put a frying pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry spoonfuls 3 minutes a side, until golden.

recipes.name: Potato rösti with fried eggs

steps.instruction: Grate {{ing:potato-large}} and {{ing:onion-medium}}. Squeeze out the water in a clean tea towel.
Melt half of {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a frying pan.
Press in the potato. Fry 10 minutes, until golden underneath.
Slide onto a plate. Flip back into the pan. Fry 10 minutes more.
Fry {{ing:egg-medium}} in the rest of the butter. Serve on the rösti.

recipes.name: Salmon and dill fishcakes

steps.instruction: Poach {{ing:salmon-fillet}} in a little water in a frying pan 8 minutes. Flake.
Mix with cold {{ing:mashed-potato}}, chopped {{ing:fresh-dill}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Shape into 8 cakes. Dust with {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Wipe the pan. Fry the cakes in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 4 minutes a side, until golden.

recipes.name: Crab and spring onion cakes

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:crab-white-meat}}, {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:mayonnaise}} and sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Shape into 8 small cakes. Chill 20 minutes.
Put a frying pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Fry 3 minutes a side, until golden.
Serve with wedges of {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Ham and cheese omelette

steps.instruction: Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} with a pinch of salt.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a small frying pan on a medium heat.
Pour in the eggs. Stir gently 30 seconds, then leave 1 minute to set.
Scatter torn {{ing:ham-slice}} and grated {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} over half.
Fold over. Slide onto a plate.

recipes.name: Mushroom and herb omelette

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry in half of {{ing:butter-unsalted}} 4 minutes in a small frying pan. Tip out.
Melt the rest of the butter. Pour in beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Stir 30 seconds, then leave 1 minute to set.
Add the mushrooms and snipped {{ing:chives}}. Fold over.

recipes.name: Spinach and feta omelette

steps.instruction: Wilt {{ing:spinach}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a small frying pan 1 minute.
Pour in beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Stir 30 seconds, then leave 1 minute.
Crumble over {{ing:feta}}. Fold over.

recipes.name: Spanish tortilla

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:potato-medium}} and {{ing:onion-medium}} thinly.
Cook gently in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a frying pan 20 minutes, until soft, not brown.
Drain off most of the oil. Mix the potatoes into beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Pour back into the pan. Cook 6 minutes on a low heat, until the edges set.
Flip onto a plate. Slide back in. Cook 4 minutes more.

recipes.name: Crêpes with lemon and sugar

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:flour-plain}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} to a smooth batter.
Melt a little {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a frying pan on a medium-high heat.
Pour in a thin layer. Tilt to cover. Cook 1 minute, until golden underneath.
Flip. Cook 30 seconds.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}. Sprinkle with {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Roll up.

recipes.name: Fluffy American pancakes

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:baking-powder}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} to a thick batter.
Melt a little {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a frying pan on a medium heat.
Pour in small rounds. Cook 2 minutes, until bubbles pop on top.
Flip. Cook 1 minute.
Serve with {{ing:maple-syrup}} and {{ing:blueberries}}.

recipes.name: Vegan banana pancakes

steps.instruction: Mash {{ing:banana-medium}}. Whisk with {{ing:oat-milk}} and {{ing:flour-self-raising}}.
Put a frying pan on a medium heat. Add a little {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Pour in small rounds. Cook 2 minutes, until bubbles show.
Flip. Cook 1 minute.
Serve with {{ing:maple-syrup}} and sliced {{ing:strawberries}}.

recipes.name: Chicken and pepper quesadillas

steps.instruction: Shred {{ing:chicken-breast-roast}}. Slice {{ing:pepper-bell}} thinly.
Lay on 4 of {{ing:tortilla-wrap}} with grated {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}. Top with the other wraps.
Cook in a dry frying pan 3 minutes a side, until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges. Serve with {{ing:salsa-dip}}.

recipes.name: Crispy halloumi pittas

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:halloumi}}.
Fry in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a frying pan 2 minutes a side, until golden.
Warm {{ing:pitta-bread}} in the pan.
Fill with halloumi, sliced {{ing:tomato-medium}}, {{ing:cucumber}} and {{ing:tzatziki}}.

recipes.name: Pan-fried chickpea and herb patties

steps.instruction: Blend drained {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}}, {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:cumin-ground}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}} to a rough paste.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Shape into 12 patties.
Fry in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a frying pan 3 minutes a side, until crisp.
Whisk {{ing:tahini}} with the juice of {{ing:lemon}} and a splash of water. Drizzle over.

recipes.name: French toast with berries

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} in a wide dish.
Soak {{ing:bread-slice-medium}} 20 seconds a side.
Fry in {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a frying pan 2 minutes a side, until golden.
Top with {{ing:raspberries}} and {{ing:maple-syrup}}.
